prompt: Toggle WLAST to appear one beat early in the burst. Explain why this is a protocol violation and what a real scoreboard would flag.
expectedTakeaway: An accepted early WLAST is a protocol violation because AXI derives the burst beat count from AWLEN and does not provide early burst termination. A scoreboard should count accepted W beats for the associated write and flag WLAST whenever its position does not match AWLEN, preserving the address and beat index as debug evidence.
